name: com.threads.uiframes
description: Interactive UI frames (drawers, card strips, card decks) for both UI Toolkit and uGUI. Designers tag elements with style classes and custom properties; per-platform controllers drive the frames from touch, mouse, keyboard or gamepad through one semantic command layer. Touch support uses com.threads.touchcontroller when it is installed.

samples.description: The same drawer, card strip, card deck and vertical strip in UI Toolkit (tagged in UXML/USS) and in uGUI (tagged with UiFrameClasses and a UiFrameStyleSheet), driven by mouse, keyboard and gamepad. Build the scenes from Threads > UI Frames > Build Demo Scenes.
